name: The Whispering Grove
text: The trees of the Whispering Grove lean together as the party comes in among them, and one of the old ones takes a slow step forward.

name: The Hanging Wood
text: Old chains and rope rot from the branches of the Hanging Wood. The tree that bore them turns, slowly, to look at the living.

name: The Elder Stand
text: Two trees older than the Dark Lord's reign stand in a ring of their fallen kin, and they do not care for axes.
